truncated.time: The time limit was reached: the file holds only part of the search.

evidence.none: This search has no lines to take.

help.title: Query syntax
help.description: A search uses fields and free text; the time range is chosen in the top bar and is not part of the query.

rules.and: Conditions separated by spaces must all hold (AND): srcip:172.20.41.5 type:web
rules.or: A field's values are written with commas (OR): action:deny,blocked. There is no OR between different fields and no parentheses.
rules.not: A condition with a leading - (or NOT ) excludes: -action:accept also finds records without an action.
rules.quotes: Values with spaces and text phrases go in quotes: "login failure". A * inside quotes is not a wildcard.
rules.present: field:* finds records where the field is set, -field:* those where it is empty.
rules.none: A word without a field is free text (at least 3 characters); a word starting with “name:” where name is no field is refused: put it in quotes to search for it as text.

examples.1: A domain and its subdomains, except what was let through
examples.3: Traffic from VLAN 41 to port 80 or 443
examples.4: The DHCP records of a MAC address

help.useExample: Write this example into the query: {{query}}
help.useThisExample: Use — write this example into the query: {{query}}

speed.indexedFields: Fields marked “Indexed” (srcip:, domain:, mac:, qname:, sessionid: …) use an index and stay fast over long ranges.
speed.srcipIndex: For a client write srcip: rather than ip: — ip: cannot use an index in every table.
speed.scanUnindexed: Free text and fields without an index are scanned in time slices, newest first; when the time is used up the results are partial and “Continue” goes on.
speed.case: Free text ignores case for English letters only; İ/ı, Ş/ş, Ğ/ğ, Ü/ü, Ö/ö, Ç/ç are matched as typed.
speed.truncated: Free text is matched in the first 2,000 characters of each record; the whole line is in the raw record.
speed.time: The time range applies to the record's device time; the receive time is shown on every row as well.

topbar.searchPlaceholderLogs: Search IP, MAC, domain or text…

timeRange.note: The range may span at most {{days}} days; it applies to the record's device time.

errors.format: Write the day and time as 09.10.2026 14:30.
errors.order: The end must be after the start.
errors.tooLong: The range may span at most {{days}} days.
